Not All Physical Therapy Clinics Are the Same

Industry standards of care for physical therapy meet the minimum acceptable for treatment. Oasis PT is about more than maintaining minimum standards, and that’s why we have developed our own Standards of Care & Performance

Our mission is to provide high-quality one-on-one patient care in an environment that promotes wellness and improves the lives of those we treat.

We specialize in providing hands-on manual therapy for low back and neck injuries, car accidents, work injuries, sports injuries and just about any other pain that is keeping you from enjoying life. 

Our unparalleled commitment is to make sure you are successful in your rehab and that you "get your life back." This is why so many doctors are referring their patients to us for their physical therapy needs.
